text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bahraini press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Arab Fund for Economic and Social Development lends Bahrain 18.75 million dinars to finance new housing projects.
- State Security Court adjourns the trial of 59 suspects accused of joining an attempt to topple the government until March 10.
- Salary increases will apply to Bahrainis and foreigners, finance minister says. Bahrain last month allocated 45 million dinars for wage increases for government employees in fiscal 1997 and 1998.
- Bahrain to launch new English-language newspaper, Bahrain Tribune, on Saturday.
- Gulf Arab states hail Bahrain-Qatar decision to open embassies in each other's capital.
